title: Wealthy Habit: Avoiding Lifestyle Inflation

scenes.text: Did you know a $5,000 raise can cost you $15,000 over five years?
scenes.query2: how raises lead to higher spending

scenes.text: Keep housing costs at or below 30 % of your gross income.
scenes.label: HOUSING 30 PERCENT

scenes.text: Limit discretionary spending increases to no more than 10 % of the raise.
scenes.label: LIMIT DISCRETIONARY

scenes.text: Redirect the remaining raise into retirement or investment accounts.
scenes.label: INVEST THE EXTRA

scenes.text: Follow for the wealth lessons school skipped.
scenes.query2: subscribe money habits call to action

description: Discover the three concrete steps wealthy people use to prevent lifestyle creep and keep their net worth climbing. Apply these rules now.
